DOB: 05/12/1948           ACCT #: 100000010
PROC. TYPE: Bilateral Renal US  PROC DATE: 01/24/2024
RADIOLOGY REPORT
================================================================================

Bilateral Renal US:

CLINICAL INDICATION: ELEVATED CREATININE. ACUTE RENAL FAILURE.

Findings:

Ultrasound examination of the kidneys shows marked atrophy of the right kidney
which measures 7.0 x 3.6 x 3.6 centimeters with left kidney measuring
10.0 x 5.4 x 3.4 centimeters. There is increased echotexture of both kidneys
which is nonspecific but can be seen with multiple medical renal abnormalities.
No hydronephrosis is evident. The pancreatic body incidentally is grossly normal
although the tail is not visualized due to bowel gas. The aorta is normal
proximally. Ureteral jets were not visualized.

IMPRESSION:

Small right kidney with increased cortical echogenicity within both kidneys.

Electronically Signed by
Dr. IMAGINE M.D.      01/24/2024
RADIOLOGIST
